title: G48 · 拒绝
body: I changed only primesUpTo, replacing its odd-only segmented sieve with an exact 30-wheel segmented sieve that scans 46.7% fewer candidate cells and performs roughly 65% fewer composite-marking writes while preserving ascending output, prime-square handling, and all other exports unchanged. I also renamed the statically forbidden local identifier `global` to `candidateIndex`, resolving the guard rejection without changing the algorithm.
